hints.title: Upper Bound on Pairs
hints.text: At most n // 2 pairs can ever be marked since each operation requires two distinct indices.

hints.title: Greedy Partition Strategy
hints.text: Sort the array. If k pairs can be matched, the optimal candidate pairs the smallest k elements with the largest k elements.

hints.title: Monotonic Pointer Matching
hints.text: Start index i at 0 and index j at (n + 1) // 2. Whenever 2 * nums[i] <= nums[j], pair them and advance i; otherwise only advance j.

hints.title: Greedy Two-Pointer Index Matching Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); greedy pointer iteration takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary matching without sorting can leave smaller numbers unable to find eligible doubles.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Observes that at most n // 2 pairs exist and greedy split between halves is optimal.
